fourControls.postcondition: Exact successful expected owned tree with every original descendant and genuine binary label; no error. The unrelated numeric row remains in the supplied graph, never skipped.

fourControls.postcondition: Each required-population corruption fails closed. No metadata placeholder or row filtering returns a tree. Existing graph/read/root/liveness tests remain unchanged.

fourControls.title: confirms the exact original stopped inventory despite unrelated unknown metadata
fourControls.input: Capture the valid original tree, then present the same full graph with all original descendants known stopped/live, strict fake signal0 ALIVE, and one unrelated valid-identity UNKNOWN-metadata row.
fourControls.postcondition: One fresh confirmation returns exactly the original observed set, preserving order; no PID substitution, omitted probe, per-PID command query or extra ps read.

fourControls.title: requires strict metadata for original members after reparenting during confirmation
fourControls.input: Capture valid original tree; reparent the original transient PID to PID1 in the next coherent snapshot. With its original known binary and stopped/live state, strict signal0 ALIVE confirms the full original set. Change only that original member metadata to UNKNOWN, then separately add a new currently reachable descendant with UNKNOWN metadata.
fourControls.postcondition: Valid reparenting retains and confirms the original member. Unknown metadata of either the reparented original member or a currently reachable descendant fails closed; original inventory remains frozen and unchanged.
